Name: Pro Scooter Madd MGP VX8 Team (Gold)
Natural: The VX8 Team pro scooter from Madd Gear scooters is a sweet selection of parts and powerfull color combinations put together in a scooter that is ready for relentless thrashings at the skatepark. The updated chrome plated fade bar looks killer and merged with a Standard HIC compression system it will surely have you doing effortless barspins all day. The Team edition has always been a great bang-for-your-buck pro scooter and the VX8 is no exception. Available in a fresh range of color combinations with logo details throughout.
